note: Strategic paths and vendors under consideration. Nothing here is a recommendation until the evaluation is done.

paths.name: Renew or renegotiate GlobalWave
paths.summary: Keep the incumbent on new terms, possibly with upgrades.
for: Lowest delivery risk against the deadline
Gives a price baseline and leverage
against: Does not fix current pain points unless the product changes
No native link to the bank's new Abrigo risk rating (unverified)
paths.toLearn: What users think of it today, its roadmap, and renewal pricing.

paths.name: Replace with a new commercial LOS
paths.summary: Run a competitive selection and implement a new platform by August 2028.
for: Chance to fix workflow and adoption issues
Room for automation as the bank grows to $5B
against: Needs integration work with COCC, LaserPro, Identifi
paths.toLearn: Verified integration references, real pricing, and implementation timelines from peer banks.

vendors.name: Global Wave Group, Credit Track (incumbent)
vendors.notes: Product confirmed as real. Include as a renewal baseline unless leadership rules it out (D03).

vendors.notes: Bank already uses Abrigo for risk rating. The 'APX' name was not found; integrations to COCC and LaserPro need live references.

vendors.name: nCino Commercial Banking
vendors.notes: Salesforce-based. Vendor reports community bank implementations under 6 months on average. Admin burden is the open question.

vendors.name: Moody's Lending Suite (CreditLens)
vendors.notes: Now includes Numerated, the small business platform named in the source.

vendors.name: Baker Hill NextGen
vendors.notes: Origination and portfolio risk platform with recent bank clients.

vendors.name: Teslar Software
vendors.notes: Lending workflow platform aimed at community banks.

vendors.name: Jack Henry Origination
vendors.notes: Mainly aimed at Jack Henry core clients. Check fit with COCC before investing time.

smallBusiness.name: Abrigo small business lending
smallBusiness.notes: Shares a platform with the Abrigo LOS. Features unverified.

smallBusiness.name: Numerated
smallBusiness.notes: Strong borrower experience per source. Ownership and integrations unverified.

criteria.detail: Proven time to go-live at banks our size, and fit with the August 2028 target.
